A pure polynomial in eps with no temperature coupling leaves NMSE about 0.17, so the coupling is essential. My search over simple basis products (up to four terms) did not reach an exact fit either.

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2)*L+(p[3]+p[4]*T)*eps+(p[5]+p[6]*T+p[7]*T**2)*eps**2+(p[8]+p[9]*T)/eps
